about: The 263 Powers. Mechanics and a one-line summary written for this app; the book's own text is never in this file. range is the Range Table column the power's text or its section states, null where neither does. bonus, optional and nemesis list the Powers the text names, by code where the name matches a Power and by name where it does not (a category, or a Power described rather than named). The full text lives only in D1 (msh_power_text), loaded from a gitignored extraction.

powers.name: Body Armor
powers.summary: Worn protective suit whose rank sets how much damage it stops; other powers may be built into it but can break down.

powers.name: Force Field
powers.summary: Projects a protective barrier spanning a tenth of the rank number in areas; attacks at or below rank are fully stopped.

powers.name: Force Field vs. Emotion
powers.summary: Area barrier shielding everyone inside from emotion and Intuition attacks; rank must exceed the hero's Intuition.

powers.name: Force Field vs. Energy
powers.summary: Area barrier that blocks emitted energy such as light, heat, radiation, electricity and sonics for all inside it.

powers.name: Force Field vs. Magic
powers.summary: Area barrier guarding everyone inside against magical attacks; its rank may sit below the hero's Psyche.

powers.name: Force Field vs. Mental
powers.summary: Area barrier guarding occupants from psionic and neural attacks; rank must be above the hero's Psyche.

powers.name: Force Field vs. Physical
powers.summary: Area barrier against blows, chemicals, disease, heat and cold; it keeps hazards out but does not supply air.

powers.name: Force Field vs. Power Manipulation
powers.summary: Area barrier protecting occupants from attacks that seize, weaken or control their powers.

powers.name: Force Field vs. Vampirism
powers.summary: Area barrier shielding occupants from every kind of draining or vampiric attack.

powers.name: Reflection
powers.summary: Bounces attacks back, more with a better FEAT; excess over rank gets through, and repeated breaches risk failure.

powers.name: Resist: Emotion
powers.summary: Ignores emotion and Intuition attacks below rank and cuts stronger ones by the rank number.

powers.name: Resist: Energy
powers.summary: Ignores emitted-energy attacks below rank and lowers stronger ones by the rank number; can specialise for +1CS.

powers.name: Resist: Magic
powers.summary: Ignores magic below rank and trims stronger spells by the rank number; rank may be lower than Psyche.

powers.name: Resist: Mental
powers.summary: Shrugs off psionic and neural attacks on the mind; rank is set at least one step above Psyche.

powers.name: Resist: Physical
powers.summary: Ignores blows, toxins, disease and harsh conditions below rank and reduces stronger harm by the rank number.

powers.name: Resist: Power Manipulation
powers.summary: Ignores attempts to control or weaken the hero's powers below rank and blunts stronger ones by the rank number.

powers.name: Resist: Vampirism
powers.summary: Ignores draining attacks below rank; against stronger drains, subtract this rank number from the attacker's.

powers.name: Abnormal Sensitivity
powers.summary: Vision or hearing is shifted to a different band, perceiving normally hidden signals while missing ordinary ones.

powers.name: Circular Vision
powers.summary: Sees in every direction at once; the odd-eyed version grants +1CS Fighting but costs -1CS Popularity. Unranked.

powers.name: Energy Detection
powers.summary: Senses and identifies active energy out to rank range; cannot sense stored energy or the people emitting it.

powers.name: Environmental Awareness
powers.summary: Constantly aware of weather, chemicals, motion and life nearby; reaching past rank range takes a FEAT.

powers.name: Extradimensional
powers.summary: Perceives other dimensions; the rank number is how many separate dimensions the hero can look into.

powers.name: Hyper-Hearing
powers.summary: Picks up faint or unusual sounds and identifies things by them; sonic attacks gain +1CS against the hero.

powers.name: Hyper-Olfactory
powers.summary: Identifies trace substances by scent; if the hero loses the knack of filtering odors, -1CS to Reason and Endurance.

powers.name: Hyper-Touch
powers.summary: Feels minute surface texture and can tell what a material is just by touching it.

powers.name: Life Detection
powers.summary: Senses living things within rank range and what kind they are; a red FEAT picks one out or reads its biology.

powers.name: Magic Detection
powers.summary: Senses and identifies magic, active or latent; FEATs reveal past spell use (green), caster (yellow), spell (red).

powers.name: Microscopic Vision
powers.summary: Magnifies tiny objects; rank sets the limit, from microfilm at Feeble down to subatomic worlds at CL5000.

powers.name: Penetration Vision
powers.summary: Sees through solid material to a depth in feet equal to the rank number; one chosen substance blocks it.

powers.name: Power Detection
powers.summary: Senses superhuman powers and who used them; harder FEATs identify the power, its user, or traces left on targets.

powers.name: Psionic Detection
powers.summary: Senses psionic ability, active or latent; harder FEATs reveal past use, the specific power and its owner.

powers.name: Radarsense
powers.summary: Builds a 3-D picture of surroundings from electromagnetic echoes; -1CS against electrical and magnetic attacks.

powers.name: Sonar
powers.summary: Maps surroundings by reflected sound, passively or by emitting pings; -1CS when resisting sonic attacks.

powers.name: Telescopic Vision
powers.summary: Sees faraway objects in line of sight, even other worlds, and can extend the reach of other vision powers.

powers.name: Thermal Vision
powers.summary: Sees heat and infrared, allowing sight in darkness and reading of temperature traces; -1CS against bright heat.

powers.name: Tracking
powers.summary: Follows the trail of a chosen target; at high ranks the trail can be followed across space.

powers.name: True Sight
powers.summary: Sees past disguises and concealment up to its rank, with harder FEATs for higher ones; range is one area.

powers.name: UV Vision
powers.summary: Sees ultraviolet, giving +1CS through fog and water and seeing radioactive glow; -2CS against UV glare.

powers.name: Weakness Detection
powers.summary: Spots flaws in a target; low ranks find physical faults, middle ranks mental too, Monstrous+ also power faults.

powers.name: Absorption Power
powers.summary: Converts one energy type into healing, gaining Health equal to rank each time struck; can replace food and air.

powers.name: Catalytic Control
powers.summary: Speeds, slows or alters chemical reactions, shifting their energy by the rank number; lasting on objects.

powers.name: Coldshaping
powers.summary: Shapes and redirects existing cold, raising or lowering it by rank; can build ice or frozen-gas constructs.

powers.name: Darkforce Manipulation
powers.summary: Creates and wields shadowy extradimensional Darkforce: blunt attacks, darkness, slower flight, portals, solid shapes.

powers.name: Electrical Control
powers.summary: Commands existing electricity, shaping it and changing its strength by rank; can run devices with a FEAT.

powers.name: Energy Conversion
powers.summary: Turns one energy type into another at one rank lower; starts with a single conversion and learns more as stunts.

powers.name: Energy Solidification
powers.summary: Forms energy into solid-seeming constructs with Strength equal to rank; harder shapes need higher FEATs.

optional.name: any Energy Emission or Energy Control Power

powers.name: Energy Sponge
powers.summary: Soaks up energy up to the rank number without harm and can release it later at -2CS; overloading is dangerous.

powers.name: Energy Vampirism
powers.summary: Drains energy from objects or beings, boosting Strength, Endurance, Psyche and powers; must feed or weaken hourly.

powers.name: Fire Control
powers.summary: Controls existing fire, changing its strength up to rank and molding it into shapes; resists fire and heat.

powers.name: Gravity Manipulation
powers.summary: Raises or lowers gravity by the rank number on self or a target, allowing levitation, pinning and redirection.

powers.name: Hard Radiation Control
powers.summary: Controls existing radiation: redirects it, changes its type, and alters its strength or damage by rank.

powers.name: Kinetic Control
powers.summary: Controls motion energy, changing its strength by rank, deflecting moving targets and reshaping kinetic attacks.

powers.name: Light Control
powers.summary: Alters existing light's brightness, color and focus, bends it and forms crude holograms; +1CS versus light attacks.

powers.name: Magnetic Manipulation
powers.summary: Controls magnetism, altering it by rank, flipping polarity and shaping fields; can disable or run machines.

powers.name: Plasma Control
powers.summary: Shapes existing plasma fields, alters their strength by rank, resists plasma, and can counter plasma-based powers.

powers.name: Radiowave Control
powers.summary: Controls radio and microwaves: changes strength, jams signals and fakes broadcasts, with harder FEATs for richer ones.

powers.name: Shadowshaping
powers.summary: Moves, resizes and shapes ordinary shadows into forms that deal rank damage; sees through dim shadows.

powers.name: Sound Manipulation
powers.summary: Amplifies or mutes existing sound, resists sonic attacks, and can boost other sound powers by +1CS.

powers.name: Thermal Control
powers.summary: Manipulates active heating or cooling (not ambient temperature), countering or strengthening thermal powers.

powers.name: Vibration Control
powers.summary: Controls vibrations, altering them by rank; can calm quakes, silence voices, disrupt gyroscopes or phase.

powers.name: Cold Generation
powers.summary: Chills a target by 10x, 20x or 40x the rank number in degrees, set by the FEAT color; resists cold.

powers.name: Electrical Generation
powers.summary: Fires electricity for rank damage through air, water or metal; contact-only use gives +2CS; resists electricity.

powers.name: Energy Doppelganger
powers.summary: Sends out an energy duplicate that flies and may carry the hero's powers; harm to it comes off the hero's Psyche.

powers.name: Fire Generation
powers.summary: Hurls flame for rank damage and range, but needs oxygen; gains +1CS against cold and water powers.

powers.name: Hard Radiation
powers.summary: Projects UV, X-rays, particle or cosmic radiation for rank damage and range; specialising in one type adds +1CS.

powers.name: Heat
powers.summary: Emits pure heat for rank effects, working even underwater or without air; strong against cold and water powers.

powers.name: Kinetic Bolt
powers.summary: Strikes with a shapeable surge of force for rank damage and range; affects solid matter only.

powers.name: Light Emission
powers.summary: Blasts light for rank damage: plain light to blind or illuminate, lasers that burn, or concussive optic beams.

powers.name: Magnetism
powers.summary: Generates magnetic fields that pull, push and magnetize metal and scramble electronics; draws metal attacks +2CS.

powers.name: Plasma Generation
powers.summary: Fires charged-particle fields for rank force damage plus two lesser side effects such as heat or radiation.

powers.name: Radiowave Generation
powers.summary: Emits radio and microwaves that disrupt electronics at rank, or cook a living target at -2CS damage and range.

powers.name: Shadowcasting
powers.summary: Projects darkness that weakens light and, at higher ranks, heat, radiation, radio and energy beings.

powers.name: Sonic Generation
powers.summary: Unleashes powerful sound for rank damage and range and disrupts other sonic powers; needs a medium to travel.

powers.name: Vibration
powers.summary: Creates silent tremors for rank damage that can sicken living targets, cancel vocal powers and shield the hero.

powers.name: Berserker
powers.summary: Enters a combat frenzy: Reason and Psyche fall to Feeble, the lost points boost Strength and Fighting, plus Iron Will.

powers.name: Martial Supremacy
powers.summary: Adds rank to a chosen Martial Arts talent, allowing rank-level damage to objects; can apply to one weapon skill.

powers.name: Natural Weaponry
powers.summary: Body has built-in weapons whose material strength equals rank; losing them costs Fighting equal to their rank.

powers.name: Weapons Creation
powers.summary: Conjures remembered weapons, rank-number ounces a turn; each ounce costs 1 Health, and a FEAT sets how long it lasts.

powers.name: Weapons Tinkering
powers.summary: Builds any weapon from available materials; green, yellow or red FEAT by its cost versus rank; specialists gain +2CS.

powers.name: Animate Image
powers.summary: Makes a flat picture seem to step out as a moving 3-D illusion; realism needs line of sight and a Reason FEAT.

powers.name: Illusion-Casting
powers.summary: Casts visible, camera-detectable illusions anywhere in range while concentrating; viewers resist with Intuition.

powers.name: Illusory Invisibility
powers.summary: Wraps the hero or an area with an image of empty space, radius in feet equal to rank; fools sight and cameras.

powers.name: Illusory Duplication
powers.summary: Creates up to rank-number illusory copies of self that the hero sees, hears and speaks through at range.

powers.name: Biophysical Control
powers.summary: Touch-based control of a body's biology in one chosen mode: heal, regrow, revive, absorb wounds, rot, harm or age.

powers.name: Bio-Vampirism
powers.summary: Pins a victim and drains Health each turn to boost own abilities; ranks fade hourly unless the character keeps feeding.

powers.name: Body Transformation-Others
powers.summary: Converts a living subject's body into another substance, life form or energy field; the victim survives meanwhile.

powers.name: Emotion Control
powers.summary: Imposes one chosen emotion on everyone in range; narrowing to a single fixed emotion earns +2CS.

powers.name: Exorcism
powers.summary: Breaks outside control such as possession or domination on a nearby subject and sends the controller home.

powers.name: Force Field vs. Hostiles
powers.summary: A mind-reading barrier that shoves away anyone meaning harm while letting friends through; blocks melee, not missiles.

powers.name: Forced Reincarnation
powers.summary: Catches a spirit, holds it, then binds it into a new host body, keeping its mind and mental powers.

powers.name: Grafting
powers.summary: Psionic surgery that keeps a patient alive through any operation, from routine repairs to brain swaps.

powers.name: Hypnotic Control
powers.summary: Plants spoken or triggered commands in a target, acting now or later; red FEAT to override their morals.

powers.name: Mind Control
powers.summary: Psionically seizes a mind as puppet, possession, total shutdown, or boosts its mental ranks.

powers.name: Mind Transferral
powers.summary: Swaps minds between bodies, or copies one mind into several, moving mental traits but no physical ones.

powers.name: Neural Manipulation
powers.summary: Scrambles a target's nerve signals to numb, freeze, convulse or overdrive their voluntary muscles.

powers.name: Plague Carrier
powers.summary: Carries germs to infect targets with collected diseases at will; can also draw a disease out of a patient.

powers.name: Plant Control
powers.summary: Makes ordinary plants aware and mobile so they follow simple orders; rank sets how many and for how long.

powers.name: Plant Growth
powers.summary: Grows plants huge almost instantly, even without soil or light; the forced growth dies off quickly.

powers.name: Sense Alteration
powers.summary: Shuts off, distorts, or shares a target's senses, up to making a group perceive the same hallucination.

powers.name: Shapechange-Others
powers.summary: Reshapes other creatures into any outward form while their inner biology stays the same.

powers.name: Sleep-Induced
powers.summary: Knocks everyone in range into a helpless slumber lasting the power's duration plus 1-10 hours.

powers.name: Spirit Storage
powers.summary: Traps any number of spirits in an inner pocket realm; capture odds depend on power rank versus their Psyche.

powers.name: Summoning
powers.summary: Calls an otherworldly being to the character and binds it to carry out one task; stronger beings are riskier.

powers.name: Undead Control
powers.summary: Commands corporeal undead to do tasks; mindless ones are easy, clever ones like vampires need a red FEAT.

powers.name: Enchantment
powers.summary: Stores spells inside a mindless object, total rank capped by this power, released by a trigger set at casting.

powers.name: Energy Source
powers.summary: A drawback: magic flows from an outside source; if cut off, spells drain a reserve equal to Psyche. Grants a reroll.

powers.name: Internal Limbo
powers.summary: The mage's body is a doorway to a vast pocket realm whose setting and moods the mage controls.

powers.name: Magic Control
powers.summary: Redirects, reshapes, boosts, weakens or cancels other magic within range, but never the mage's own.

powers.name: Magic Creation
powers.summary: Grants magical powers to others at 3CS below this rank; how long they last depends on a Reason roll.

powers.name: Magic Domination
powers.summary: Takes over another spellcaster, forcing them to cast their spells as the mage wishes; only affects magic users.

powers.name: Magic Transferral
powers.summary: Lends some of the mage's own spell ranks to another being, losing that amount while the loan lasts.

powers.name: Magic Vampirism
powers.summary: Leeches magic from items or beings to raise own abilities; the gains drain away hourly without more feeding.

powers.name: Power Simulation
powers.summary: Reroll for a normal power that is then cast as a spell; all later powers are magical too.

powers.name: Reality Alteration
powers.summary: Bends time in one rolled form: nudge future odds, overlay an alternate present, rewrite the past, or speed/slow time.

powers.name: Spirit Vampirism
powers.summary: Drains a victim's Intuition and Psyche to power up own abilities; must keep feeding or ranks decline.

powers.name: Sympathetic Magic
powers.summary: Uses a doll holding the victim's hair or similar to channel harm and mind or life powers at one target.

powers.name: Warding
powers.summary: Sets magical traps on locations that unleash stored powers once a chosen trigger occurs.

powers.name: Bonding
powers.summary: Fuses touching solid objects together; the bond gains strength each turn held, up to the power rank.

powers.name: Collection
powers.summary: Gathers a chosen material scattered across the area and teleports it into a pile at a visible spot.

powers.name: Crystallization
powers.summary: Turns matter or airborne dust into tough crystal of rank strength; living targets freeze in suspended animation.

powers.name: Diminution
powers.summary: Shrinks a visible target; higher ranks reach cell, atom or microverse scale by one of three methods.

powers.name: Disruption
powers.summary: Breaks a target's molecular bonds so it crumbles into dust, liquid or gas; weight per turn set by rank.

powers.name: Enlargement
powers.summary: Makes a nearby target grow up to many times its size, by one of three methods with different side effects.

powers.name: Geoforce
powers.summary: Senses and steers earth forces: trigger or calm quakes, open pits and tunnels, even raise small volcanoes.

powers.name: Matter Animation
powers.summary: Moves and shapes natural air, liquid or solid matter (one form) as long as the character concentrates.

powers.name: Machine Animation
powers.summary: Remotely runs and powers machines, even unplugged; robots resist with Psyche, and extra machines cut range.

powers.name: Micro-Environment
powers.summary: Wraps the character in a shielded bubble of breathable air and comfortable conditions, cutting hazards by rank.

powers.name: Molding
powers.summary: Reshapes solid matter into any form, even working devices, at a range and weight set by rank.

powers.name: Weather
powers.summary: Commands local weather: heat, wind, humidity, clouds, rain and lightning, for minutes a day equal to Health.

powers.name: Zombie Animation
powers.summary: Raises corpses as mindless servants after a prep period; directly controls as many as the Psyche rank number.

powers.name: Coloration
powers.summary: Changes the color, light frequency or transparency of anything, for effects like dimming, heating or seeing through.

powers.name: Combustion
powers.summary: Makes the outer layer of a target flammable so it bursts into flame a few turns later, dealing rank damage.

powers.name: Disintegration
powers.summary: A beam that turns matter into harmless light; cubic feet per turn equal the rank number, needs an Agility FEAT.

powers.name: Elemental Conversion
powers.summary: Transmutes matter into any single element, pounds per turn by rank; lethal to living tissue unless temporary.

powers.name: Ionization
powers.summary: Energizes a target's atoms to build static charge, emit electricity, break it apart, warm it or phase it.

powers.name: Molecular Conversion
powers.summary: Rebuilds matter into any chosen compound; more complex molecules need harder FEATs. Weight per turn by rank.

powers.name: Artifact Creation
powers.summary: Conjures one-piece objects from memorized designs, ounces per turn by rank, each ounce costing a Health point.

powers.name: Elemental Creation
powers.summary: Materializes pure elements nearby, ounces per turn by rank at a Health cost; can be dropped on foes as an attack.

powers.name: Lifeform Creation
powers.summary: Creates living creatures from studied or invented designs, ounces per turn by rank, paying Health per ounce.

powers.name: Mechanical Creation
powers.summary: Builds working machines from memorized designs, ounces per turn by rank, spending a Health point per ounce.

powers.name: Missile Creation
powers.summary: Creates and fires stunning projectiles, optionally carrying another power's effect; hourly shots limited by rank.

powers.name: Molecular Creation
powers.summary: Forms any compound out of nothing nearby, ounces per turn by rank, costing Health; usable as a dodgeable attack.

powers.name: Spray
powers.summary: Releases a short-range cloud that chokes and blinds, and can deliver another power's effect; daily uses by rank.

powers.name: Webcasting
powers.summary: Shoots sticky webbing to snare foes, swing between spots or form shields; can carry other powers. Daily uses by rank.

powers.name: Clairaudience
powers.summary: Listen in on faraway places through any barrier or vacuum, but psionic and sonic attacks there hit you at -1CS.

powers.name: Clairvoyance
powers.summary: View remote scenes unhindered by distance or walls; psionic and light attacks aimed there can reach you at -1CS.

powers.name: Communicate with Animals
powers.summary: Talk with animals and non-sentient creatures; mammals need green, birds and reptiles yellow, all others red.

powers.name: Communicate with Cybernetics
powers.summary: Converse with any programmed device; multi-chip computers are green, single-chip gadgets yellow, chipless ones red.

powers.name: Communicate with Non-Living
powers.summary: Lend awareness to objects or corpses so they answer questions, letting you quiz belongings about their owner.

powers.name: Communicate with Plants
powers.summary: Converse with plant life; trees are easiest (green), shrubs yellow, fungi and simple plants red.

powers.name: Cosmic Awareness
powers.summary: Learn nearly anything by FEAT and gain +1CS on attacks, but frequent use risks a Reason check against insanity.

powers.name: Danger Sense
powers.summary: Warns of danger seconds ahead and may stand in for Intuition, Fighting, Agility or Strength in combat.

powers.name: Dreamtravel
powers.summary: Step into a nearby sleeper's dream world, using this rank for all physical stats; injuries there are real.

powers.name: Empathy
powers.summary: Read the feelings of others and broadcast your own emotions as a signal; each extra target cuts range -1CS.

powers.name: Free Spirit
powers.summary: Your spirit can leave the body, carry your mental abilities, and persist after death with a red FEAT.

powers.name: Hallucinations
powers.summary: Plant illusions only the target can see while you concentrate; wounds they believe in can knock them out.

powers.name: Hyper-Intelligence
powers.summary: Boost Reason or Intuition, either permanently by this rank or temporarily by many column shifts for minutes.

powers.name: Hyper-Invention
powers.summary: Master, repair and build technology cheaply; FEAT color depends on how much instruction material you have.

powers.name: Incarnation Awareness
powers.summary: Recall and talk to as many past lives as your rank number, even asking them to set up plans that pay off now.

powers.name: Iron Will
powers.summary: Soak up to rank-number damage per hit and resist with this rank; releasing it costs half the stored damage as Health.

powers.name: Linguistics
powers.summary: Learn tongues fast, keeping as many as your rank number; also grants rank resistance to sonic mind control.

powers.name: Mental Duplication
powers.summary: Copy another mind into your own, gaining memories, talents or mental powers by FEAT color, for Psyche-based minutes.

powers.name: Mental Invisibility
powers.summary: Hide your mind from all detection, giving rank resistance to probes and psionic attacks; shielding others is -1CS each.

powers.name: Mental Probe
powers.summary: Search a mind or psychic phenomenon for specific information; a target that resists bars retries for a day.

powers.name: Mind Blast
powers.summary: Psionic bolt deals rank damage to the nervous system; a failed Psyche FEAT also knocks the target out 1-10 turns.

powers.name: Mind Drain
powers.summary: Each use strips rank points from both Reason and Intuition of a victim; zero in both makes the loss permanent.

powers.name: Postcognition
powers.summary: Touch a person, object or place to relive its past up to rank-number weeks back; FEAT color sets vision accuracy.

powers.name: Precognition
powers.summary: Glimpse events up to twice rank-number hours ahead under a chosen limit; the Judge rolls secretly for accuracy.

powers.name: Psionic Vampirism
powers.summary: Feed on a victim's mind to pump up your stats and powers, which otherwise decay one point every hour.

powers.name: Remote Sensing
powers.summary: Project one chosen non-sight, non-hearing sense to a distance; psionic attacks against you gain +1CS.

powers.name: Sensory Link
powers.summary: Borrow the senses of any creature in sight unnoticed, at -1CS to psionic resistance, Agility and Fighting.

powers.name: Serial Immortality
powers.summary: On death your life force moves into a new body by one of five methods, keeping some of your powers.

powers.name: Speechthrowing
powers.summary: Make your voice sound at any far location instantly, through any barrier that does not block psionics.

powers.name: Telekinesis
powers.summary: Move objects with the mind using rank as Strength; each extra simultaneous action shortens range -1CS.

powers.name: Telelocation
powers.summary: Find a chosen quarry anywhere in range with no trail needed; FEAT color depends on your link to the target.

powers.name: Telepathy
powers.summary: Mind-to-mind contact, easy with weaker or willing minds and harder against strong or shielded ones.

powers.name: Total Memory
powers.summary: Recall anything ever experienced, with accuracy equal to rank number as a percent; old mind attacks may resurface.

powers.name: Armor Skin
powers.summary: Toughened skin subtracts rank number from physical and energy attacks; a switchable version costs -2CS.

powers.name: Body Resistance
powers.summary: Normal-looking flesh subtracts rank number from physical and energy damage and heals surface wounds ten times faster.

powers.name: Chemical Touch
powers.summary: Your skin secretes substances that, blended with another of your powers, deal rank damage by contact.

powers.name: Digestive Adaptation
powers.summary: Eat and digest anything safely, converting it to useful matter, with +4CS resistance to swallowed toxins.

powers.name: Hyper-Speed
powers.summary: Move or work faster by a multiple equal to rank number, possibly past light speed; skip adaptations for +2CS.

powers.name: Hypnotic Voice
powers.summary: Anyone hearing you must pass an Intuition FEAT or obey; strength falls -1CS per 20 feet and through recordings.

powers.name: Lung Adaptability
powers.summary: Breathe any gas or liquid by converting it inside your lungs, shrugging off airborne poisons.

powers.name: Pheromones
powers.summary: Emit scents that command those who smell them; rank drops -1CS per 20 feet beyond the first 20.

powers.name: Regeneration
powers.summary: Heal at a rate multiplied by rank number and eventually regrow lost limbs or organs with a red FEAT.

powers.name: Self-Revival
powers.summary: Your body repairs even fatal harm and brings you back to life; FEAT color depends on how much body remains.

powers.name: Self-Sustenance
powers.summary: Go without air, food or water; a temporary version gives +1CS but you must binge afterwards.

powers.name: Stealth
powers.summary: Your rank is subtracted from anyone trying to spot or track you.

powers.name: Suspended Animation
powers.summary: Enter a deathlike trance that ignores hostile conditions, waking later on a set time, trigger or outside help.

powers.name: True Invulnerability
powers.summary: Lowers the rank of nearly every physical or energy attack by this rank, but not magic or mental attacks.

powers.name: Vocal Control
powers.summary: Mimic any voice or sound perfectly within your rank, and copy sonic powers at -1CS of the original.

powers.name: Waterbreathing
powers.summary: Breathe water or another chosen medium; the permanent form suffers -1CS and +1CS damage from heat and dryness.

powers.name: Water Freedom
powers.summary: Move through water as easily as air and ignore deep pressure; on land +2CS Strength and Endurance, -2CS Agility.

powers.name: Control
powers.summary: Steer, boost or shrink, or cancel the powers of others in range, for up to rank-number minutes at a time.

powers.name: Creation
powers.summary: Grant new powers to others at -3CS of this rank, up to rank-number kinds; a Reason FEAT sets how long they last.

powers.name: Domination
powers.summary: Force super-beings to use their own powers as you command, against their Psyche; no effect on the powerless.

powers.name: Duplication
powers.summary: Copy one power you have been exposed to at this rank, storing up to rank-number powers; swapping takes 3 turns.

powers.name: Energy Source
powers.summary: Your powers run off an external source; if cut off, you get a pool of points equal to Psyche. Roll another power.

powers.name: Energy Source Creation
powers.summary: Charge a non-living object with powers so others can later unleash them, up to limits set by this rank.

powers.name: Focus
powers.summary: Pour every ability and power total into one power for a single burst, then drop to Feeble and recover. Roll again.

powers.name: Gestalt
powers.summary: Join with a partner character to produce a randomly rolled shared power at this rank.

powers.name: Nemesis
powers.summary: Replaces all powers: study one foe and build a power to beat it, up to this rank; useless against the powerless.

powers.name: Power Transferral
powers.summary: Lend your powers and ranks to another being, losing them meanwhile; a Reason FEAT sets how long the loan lasts.

powers.name: Power Vampirism
powers.summary: Drain power from items or beings to raise your stats and powers, which otherwise fade a point every hour.

powers.name: Residual Absorption
powers.summary: Soak up leftover traces from a power's use to gain it at this rank; a Reason FEAT sets how long it lasts.

powers.name: Selection
powers.summary: Hold many powers but use only one at a time, with three turns to switch; grants an extra power roll.

powers.name: Weakness Creation
powers.summary: Inflict a random Weakness on a victim against their Psyche; a Reason FEAT decides how long it lasts.

powers.name: Age-Shift
powers.summary: Makes the body look older or younger by a number of years set by rank; the mind stays the same.

powers.name: Alter Ego
powers.summary: Switches between an ordinary powerless self and a separately built powered self; risk of reverting at bad moments.

powers.name: Anatomical Separation
powers.summary: Detaches body parts that act and move on their own for a rank-based time and range; +1CS against edged attacks.

powers.name: Animal Transformation
powers.summary: Reshapes the body into any animal or non-humanoid alien look while keeping the same underlying biology.

powers.name: Animal Mimicry
powers.summary: Copies an animal's natural abilities without changing shape; harder FEATs for alien, magical or mythical beasts.

powers.name: Blending
powers.summary: Changes skin colour to match the surroundings, giving near-invisibility that works best in dim light or at range.

powers.name: Body Adaptation
powers.summary: Body automatically reshapes itself over 1-10 turns to survive a hostile environment; conscious control at Shift X.

powers.name: Body Transformation
powers.summary: Turns the body into another element or compound while staying alive; vulnerable to attacks on that material.

powers.name: Body Coating
powers.summary: Grows a protective layer of one chosen material that absorbs damage and regrows; other powers need it present.

powers.name: Bouncing Ball
powers.summary: Inflates into a bouncy sphere: moves at rank speed, adds rank to Fighting, +3CS vs blunt and -2CS vs slashing.

powers.name: Chemical Mimicry
powers.summary: Flesh behaves chemically like any chosen substance without changing composition; scent tracking suffers -4CS.

powers.name: Elongation
powers.summary: Stretches body parts up to rank number in yards total, held for up to rank number in turns.

powers.name: Energy Body
powers.summary: Becomes a living field of chosen energy types, each ranked separately, able to spend and reabsorb that energy.

powers.name: Energy Sheath
powers.summary: Wraps self in an energy field giving protection and life support; +2CS vs its own energy type, -2CS to its controllers.

powers.name: Evolution
powers.summary: Shifts to a primitive brute or advanced big-brain stage, moving ability ranks between physical and mental.

powers.name: Growth
powers.summary: Grows larger at will, becoming easier to hit; one of three rolled forms decides mass, strength and fragility.

powers.name: Imitation-Face Changer
powers.summary: Reshapes facial features, skin and hair to pass as any human of roughly the same build.

powers.name: Imitation-Human Changeling
powers.summary: Takes on any human or humanoid form, copied or invented, without gaining that person's powers or habits.

powers.name: Invisibility
powers.summary: Becomes unseen by one of four methods (light, mind, illusion, hologram), each with its own detection weaknesses.

powers.name: Mass Decrease
powers.summary: Cuts body weight to a rank-based percentage; at Shift X and above the hero floats and can bear extra load.

powers.name: Mass Increase
powers.summary: Multiplies body weight by rank number while moving normally; grants rank resistance to physical harm and charges.

powers.name: Phasing
powers.summary: Turns intangible to pass through matter weaker than the rank; lasts as long as breath is held; scrambles electronics.

powers.name: Physical Gestalt
powers.summary: Two or more ordinary people fuse into one powered hero; all must be present, and their ailments carry over.

powers.name: Plant Mimicry
powers.summary: Copies a plant's traits such as photosynthesis, rooting or a toxic touch, with FEATs harder for alien or magic plants.

powers.name: Plasticity
powers.summary: Twists and stretches the body into any shape without holes; rank resistance to blunt hits and safe long falls.

powers.name: Prehensile Hair
powers.summary: Hair moves like many tentacles to grab, strike or manipulate; action count and Str/Agil shift are set by rank.

powers.name: Self-Duplication
powers.summary: Creates copies of self with the same stats and powers, linked by telepathy; losing a copy costs no Health.

powers.name: Self-Vegetation
powers.summary: Turns into a plant form: immune to anti-animal attacks, weak to herbicides, fed by sunlight; physical stats change.

powers.name: Shapeshifting
powers.summary: Changes into any shape by FEAT while keeping flesh composition; very large or small shapes cut duration -3CS.

powers.name: Shrinking
powers.summary: Shrinks at will, becoming harder to hit but taking more damage; one of three rolled forms decides mass and strength.

powers.name: Spirit Gestalt
powers.summary: Merges with one or more spirits to become a powered alter ego; rank sets how well the merger resists being split.

powers.name: Two-dimensionality
powers.summary: Flattens to paper-thin or thinner by FEAT to slip through cracks or slice barriers; less harmed by blunt blows.

powers.name: Astral Body
powers.summary: Projects an intangible spirit form tethered by a silver cord while the body lies helpless; can cross dimensions.

powers.name: Carrier Wave
powers.summary: Rides a current of one chosen energy type at rank speed, towing a rank-Strength load; fails where that energy ends.

powers.name: Dimension Travel
powers.summary: Crosses into other dimensions; starts with home plus one more, with FEATs for precise targets or under stress.

powers.name: Energy Path
powers.summary: Converts into energy and travels along existing currents of that type at rank speed, carrying a rank-Strength load.

powers.name: Floating Disc
powers.summary: Creates a solid-light platform that carries the hero and cargo at rank speed; practical air speed tops out at RM.

powers.name: Gateway
powers.summary: Opens portals to fixed spots across distance, eras or other realms; holds a number of set destinations equal to rank.

powers.name: Gliding
powers.summary: Rides air currents at rank speed up to Mach One, sinking each turn unless Agility FEATs keep it level or climbing.

powers.name: Hyper-Digging
powers.summary: Tunnels through ground softer than the rank at rank speed; adds rank number to Strength and Endurance.

powers.name: Hyper-Leaping
powers.summary: Makes huge, safely landed jumps with distance set by rank; rank must beat Strength by at least one step.

powers.name: Hyper-Running
powers.summary: Runs at rank speed for long periods, adds rank to Endurance, and slows perceived motion so bullets can be dodged.

powers.name: Hyper-Swimming
powers.summary: Swims at rank speed, slowed -1CS per 100 feet of depth; can tow buoyant objects at -1CS.

powers.name: Levitation
powers.summary: Floats up or down at rank speed and hovers, never falling while conscious; rank resistance to wind and gravity shifts.

powers.name: Rocket
powers.summary: Flies at rank speed on a self-made exhaust jet, even in vacuum; thrust uses rank as Strength for loads.

powers.name: Skywalk
powers.summary: Walks on a self-made invisible path through the air at up to rank speed, ramping to change height.

powers.name: Spiderclimb
powers.summary: Clings to and moves over walls and ceilings at normal speed; rank sets grip, and extra weight lowers it.

powers.name: Teleport Self
powers.summary: Vanishes and reappears elsewhere within range, bringing touched items up to Strength limit; bad FEAT disorients.

powers.name: Teleport Others
powers.summary: Sends others, within a Strength-based weight cap, to a distant spot over three turns; distance to target costs CS.

powers.name: Telereformation
powers.summary: Dissolves the body, sends the life force far away, and builds a new body from materials at the destination by FEAT.

powers.name: Time Travel
powers.summary: Journeys to the past (rank x 1000 years) or future (rank x 10 years), carrying a mass equal to Strength.

powers.name: Troubleseeker
powers.summary: Uncontrollably teleports the hero to nearby emotional crises and holds him within 10 areas until they are resolved.

powers.name: True Flight
powers.summary: Flies through water, air and space at rank-set speeds; Agility sets maneuvering, with resistance to air friction.

powers.name: Water Walking
powers.summary: Firms up the water's surface so the hero can walk across it at rank speed; currents and waves alter progress.

powers.name: Whirlwind
powers.summary: Flies in a personal cyclone at rank speed up to Shift X with passengers; rank-level defence vs sonic and physical harm.
